places.name: Nohkalikai Falls
places.description: The single most dramatic waterfall in India — a 340-metre plunge into a turquoise pool with one of the most haunting local legends in Meghalaya.
places.bestTime: June to October for full flow; October to November for both flow and clear sky

places.name: Double-Decker Living Root Bridge, Nongriat
places.description: An ancient bio-engineered bridge grown from living tree roots — one of the most iconic and photographed natural structures in South Asia.
places.mapsSearch: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Nongriat Cherrapunji Meghalaya
places.bestTime: October to April for manageable trekking conditions

places.name: Seven Sisters Falls (Nohsngithiang)
places.description: The spectacle of seven parallel waterfalls falling simultaneously from a single 315-metre plateau edge is unmatched anywhere in India.
places.mapsSearch: Seven Sisters Falls Nohsngithiang Cherrapunji Meghalaya
places.bestTime: July to October for full flow

places.name: Mawsmai Cave
places.description: A walk through a narrow, dripping limestone cave with ancient formations is one of the most memorable short experiences in Meghalaya.
places.bestTime: October to March for drier passages; cave is open year-round

places.name: Cherrapunji Eco-Park and Valley Viewpoints
places.description: The best place to watch clouds form below you and rise over the plateau edge — a meteorological spectacle unique to the world's wettest region.
places.bestTime: June to October for cloud formations; October to November for valley clarity

places.name: Dainthlen Falls
places.description: A powerful waterfall with one of Meghalaya's most vivid and dark folklore traditions attached to the rock on which it falls.
places.bestTime: June to November for strong flow

places.name: Rainbow Falls, Nongriat
places.description: A permanent rainbow in a remote waterfall's mist — only reachable by the same valley trek as the famous root bridge.
places.bestTime: October to March for best rainbow visibility and dry crossings; 10 am to 2 pm for the rainbow itself

places.name: Wakaba Falls
places.description: A tall, photogenic waterfall visible directly from the main road — requires no trekking and is rarely crowded.

places.name: Mawmluh Cave
places.description: A cave whose sediments literally define a geologic Age — Mawmluh's scientific significance is global, its atmosphere primordially dark and dripping.
places.bestTime: October to March for drier interior passages

places.name: Tyrna Village and Root Bridge Trail
places.description: The village trailhead, with its traditional architecture and community atmosphere, sets the scene for one of India's great hiking experiences.
places.mapsSearch: Tyrna Village Root Bridge Trek Cherrapunji Meghalaya
